points: Architected and developed a Terminal Operating System (TOS) using microservices architecture with Golang, Apache Kafka, and MQTT on GCP, processing real-time bathymetry data for automated docking alerts.
Designed API integrations for port control systems, ensuring data interoperability between operational management and hardware/sensors.
Developed and refactored corporate ERP system modules using Java (Spring Framework), ensuring stability in the production environment.
Created Python automation scripts for systemic and operational routines, eliminating manual processes.
Participated in the full lifecycle development of corporate systems, from requirements analysis to deployment, using DDD architecture.
Developed systems for data collection, feedback management, and management dashboards.
Worked with the technology stack: MongoDB, React.js, and Node.js.
Modeled and administered the educational sector's relational database (SQL), optimizing table structures for complex queries on a large scale.
Applied Software Engineering patterns (OOP, SOLID, Clean Code) to reduce technical debt and facilitate long-term code maintenance.
